subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Free Cruise Scam
description: A 60-second lesson on The Free Cruise Scam.

hook.text: Congratulations! You've won a free cruise. Just pay $300 in taxes and port fees to claim it.

buildup.text: Free cruise calls and texts lure victims with an exciting prize that comes with hidden costs.

discovery.text: The cruise is either nonexistent, extremely low quality, or loaded with mandatory upgrade charges.

twist.text: Victims who provide credit card details often find unauthorized charges appearing for months.

climax.text: Legitimate cruise lines never call to offer free trips. The call itself is the biggest red flag.

punchline.text: The only thing sailing is your money — straight to the scammer.

quiz.question: What typically happens after paying for a 'free cruise'?
options: You get a low-quality trip or nothing, plus unauthorized charges
The cruise is delayed by a year
